narrative.overview: Collins' site is built as an engineer's set of working drawings. Every surface behaves like a drafting sheet: a black blueprint ground ruled with a faint grid, white hairline linework, dimensioned callouts, title blocks, and buy/hire stamps. The interface specifies the equipment rather than decorating it. The palette is taken from the reference competitor (SP Heavy Rental) and verified against its live site: a black ground with safety-yellow as the single action color and construction-orange as its second, with Collins' navy/blue held to the logo and line tint. Anton sets headlines in industrial caps; Spline Sans Mono carries the drawing's annotation voice; Archivo handles prose.
keyCharacteristics: Black blueprint ground with faint grid
Flat by default, CAD-style selection on hover

rules.name: The Yellow-Is-Action Rule
rules.body: Safety-yellow appears only where the visitor can act, or on the single most important accent per view. Its scarcity is the signal.

rules.name: The Drafting-Label Rule
rules.body: Monospace is reserved for measurement and labelling — specs, part numbers, dimensions, control labels, tabular numerals. Never a running sentence.

rules.name: The Flat-Blueprint Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat linework at rest. Elevation (shadow + -3px lift + 1px yellow outline) appears only on hover and reads as selecting an entity on a drawing.

rules.name: The Sharp-Corner Rule
rules.body: No rounded corners anywhere — a radius breaks the drafting metaphor.

dos: Do keep safety-yellow for action and one accent per view.
Do render every spec, code, dimension, and label in Spline Sans Mono with tabular numerals.
Do build structure from 1px hairlines and title-block/dimension motifs; separate grid cells with 1px gaps, not gutters.
Do keep corners sharp (0px) and draw icons as 1.6px-stroke SVG.
Do treat hover as CAD selection: lift + shadow + 1px yellow outline.
donts: Don't round corners, add gradient text, or use glass/blur as decoration.
Don't put a thick colored border on one side of a card — use the selection outline.
Don't set running prose in the monospace, or use yellow as a text color / decorative fill.
Don't recolor the Collins logo, or promote Collins navy/blue into a general accent.
Don't reach for the reference site's sunset-photo hero or all-yellow-buttons default.
